text:
jules: Quick sync on preflight probe UX — thinking about adding a tiny 'copy debug' affordance per host so infra teams can paste probe output into tickets. mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/probe-copy-debug (frame: copy-action). thoughts? :clipboard:
rita: Love the idea for support flows. ask: what exactly would we copy? full raw logs or a compact summary? prefer compact + link to full logs behind auth.
tom: Compact is safer. example payload: `Host: host-01
Port: 22 -> open
Latency: 18ms
Last 3: ok,ok,fail` — users can paste that. also add a copy icon with confirmation toast.
alix: A11y: copy button must be keyboard reachable and announce success via `aria-live`. also we should provide a visually-hidden message to the clipboard: "Copied network probe for host host-01".
jules: Good. couple UX nits: 1) placement: inline on the probe row vs in expanded detail? 2) show when probe is hidden by collapsed-succeeds mode?
rita: (typo: rita) inline makes it discoverable. but if we collapse successes we should show a small chevron + quick actions area on the summary that includes copy for the collapsed group. e.g., "Copy visible probes" / "Copy all" options.
tom: Implementation detail: copying many probes could be large. cap at 10 probes for "copy all" and show message: "Truncated to 10 probes for readability".
alix: For screen readers, if we offer group copy, the control should be `aria-haspopup="menu"` and the menu items are focusable. Announce counts: "Copy 4 visible probes".
jules: Microcopy proposal: `Copy` / `Copy all (max 10)` / confirmation: `Copied 4 probes to clipboard`
qa-bot: Quick accessibility checklist added: focus order, aria-live for toasts, keyboard menu access, low contrast check on summary text. See checklist: https://internal.redwood.ai/qa/checklists/probes-a11y
tom: Another thought: timeline for probe updates — currently each probe row updates in place. to reduce jank we could batch UI changes and animate height transitions. design should provide collapse placeholder heights to avoid layout shift.
rita: Copy tweak: summary banner should say "Network checks — 6 of 8 passing" (hyphen not em dash) to match other panels. Avoid words like "successful" per style guide.
alix: Keyboard behavior: when user presses Enter on a collapsed group it should expand the group and focus first failure. Also Escape while focused in the group should collapse back and return focus to the group toggle.
jules: Ok actionable list: 1) add copy affordance designs inline + group menu 2) drafts for copy strings 3) aria-live + visually-hidden confirmations 4) cap copy-all at 10 with truncation notice 5) motion/height placeholders to reduce layout shift. i'll update figma and open a PR with copy strings and the a11y checklist. tagging @rita @tom @alix for review.
qa-bot: New checklist entry: ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for any dimmed text.
tom: Small QA note — mobile tap targets: copy and expand actions need 44px min.
rita: thanks all — will review updated mocks later today. :sparkles:
